why: Every claim in the log is withheld from this view's trust base. kan omits such a subject from `show --all --json` AND from `status --json`, so day's ENUMERATING readers never see it and never reach the per-subject guard. The envelope count is the only evidence anything exists. day must not report this as an empty project. `assess docs` is DELIBERATELY ABSENT from the invocations: it exits 2 here, because AbsentUnderNarrowedTrust is keyed on a log-wide count and refuses a subject unrelated to the withholding. An erroring invocation makes the whole corpus unrunnable, so it cannot be carried while that stands. Add it back when that guard is scoped — its absence is the marker.
